title: Saudi Arabian Kebabs
description: A traditional and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish of marinated lamb kebabs, perfect for grilling or BBQing.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder or leg, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure the lamb is at room temperature before marinating.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality olive oil for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lime juice is best.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: Use pure honey for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality garam masala for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper
ingredients.notes: Add salt and black pepper to taste.

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Use fresh parsley for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh mint
ingredients.notes: Use fresh mint for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Pita bread
ingredients.notes: Use warm pita bread for the best experience.

ingredients.name: Raita (yogurt sauce)
ingredients.notes: Make a raita by mixing yogurt with cucumber, cumin, and coriander for a refreshing side dish.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, honey, garam masala, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or BBQ to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until they are cooked through to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, toast the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot with toasted pita bread, raita, and garnished with parsley and mint.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
Enjoy your delicious Saudi Arabian kebabs!
